report:
Reviewed the complete placeholder_status claim, its one ordinary implementation association and all four test entries. Verified the historical whole-file test snapshots for tests/evidence.rs and tests/spec_plan.rs are exact byte matches. The only implementation-source delta from the historical snapshot is the additional meta.reviews.decisions association comment; executable behavior is unchanged. Reassessed the prior rationale against current fragments rather than treating that comparison as approval.

Source inspection: evidence.rs placeholder_status excludes the crate component, recognizes todo and not_applicable module ancestors (including raw identifiers), preserves ordinary status otherwise, and rejects either ordering of conflicting ancestry. Scopes tracks module nesting separately from function names. index_source creates entries only for actual references, keeps individual sites for the same rule, records each status, and bounds explanations so adjacent references cannot steal one another's rationale. Comment tokenization excludes string-literal lookalikes. test_explanation retains explanatory comments independently of marker syntax. The documentation example is illustrative of a reference to an existing rule, not a new definition; neither empty modules nor their names introduce evidence.

The complete ordinary test set has meaningful assertions: implementation_status_uses_module_ancestry_and_preserves_cfg_and_explanations checks three separate same-rule sites, TODO/N/A/ordinary statuses, retained rationale, nesting, absence of entries for empty modules, and that a function named todo stays ordinary; adjacent_points_keep_their_own_explanations_even_when_previews_overlap checks both independent explanations despite overlapping previews; conflicting_placeholder_modules_are_rejected_and_test_explanations_skip_strings checks diagnostics for one nesting order, rejection of the reverse, crate-name exclusion, raw identifiers, and exclusion of a string-literal fake explanation. Captured the fixture-construction helper using review read.

The remaining associated test, todo::implementation_and_test_placeholder_status, is explicitly deferred. Its comment identifies the required separate implementation/test classification, explanations, and empty-module scenarios. It does not assert completed integration. Prerequisites for replacing it are substantive fixtures containing annotated tests and implementation references across ordinary/TODO/N/A scopes, assertions of independent sides and absence of empty-module entries, and generated-display integration proving separate presentation of same-rule entries. Full test-side/display integration remains covered by this justified visible TODO, as in the historical review; acceptance does not certify those deferred scenarios as implemented or tested. No N/A entry is associated with this anchor.

This is a source review, with baseline byte comparison and review start/read/record commands executed by this reviewer. No behavioral tests or build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator separately reports 321 functional tests and cargo build passing; those are not this reviewer's execution evidence. No source changes or requested edits.
